name: corpora
doc: Corpora's self-describing praxis contribution. It declares which of this directory's subdirs feed which of praxis's plugin slots. A project 'moves corpora in' by snapshot-importing this contribution (praxis/scripts/plugin_import.py) into its own praxis/ slots; the importer reads THIS file to know what goes where. Praxis-core names nothing corpora — it only reads the generic `provides` map. `provides` keys are praxis slot names (engine, handoff, phases, scripts); values are subdirs of this contribution whose contents are copied into the matching project slot. The engine slot gets one extra, still-generic rule: any imported manifest carrying a `cli.entry` has that entry frozen to an absolute path at import time (the snapshot), so the engine CLI location travels with the import instead of depending on where the contribution sits.
